# #3977: Patch: follow-up to #3969 from the after-merge spot-check
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

<!-- jackioh-bot:spot-check-follow-up #3969 -->
The after-merge spot-check of #3969 ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43719501458)) found 1 blocking problem(s) in the change as it merged (`9076a3e24555`). `claude-3` (claude, `opus`, strong) reviewed it. #3969 stays merged: nothing is reverted, and this issue fixes what it found in a change of its own, from `main`.

## What to fix

- [ ] `apps/web/src/together/together.css:147`: `.together-field:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--you); }` removes the app's 2 px focus outline from the add-friend and search inputs and leaves only a 1 px border colour change, which is weaker than what these fields had before and weaker than every other themed field in the app.

Fix: delete the `outline: none` line, so the theme's radiant outline stays and the border still turns `--you`. Add a component check in friends-screen.cy.tsx that a focused `TOGETHER_ADD_INPUT` / `TOGETHER_SEARCH` has a computed `outlineStyle` other than `none`.

- Each finding above is fixed where it points, or answered with the evidence that it does not hold.

## Goal

Restore the radiant focus outline on `.together-field` inputs by deleting `outline: none;` from `.together-field:focus-visible` in `together.css`, keeping the border transition to `var(--you)`. Add a component assertion in `friends-screen.cy.tsx` checking that focused `TOGETHER_ADD_INPUT` and `TOGETHER_SEARCH` elements have a computed `outlineStyle` other than `none`.

## Files to touch

| File | Status | Changes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `apps/web/src/together/together.css` | change | Remove `outline: none;` from `.together-field:focus-visible` |
| `e2e/cypress/component/friends-screen.cy.tsx` | change | In `expectThemedFields()`, focus each field with `{ focusVisible: true }` and assert computed `outlineStyle !== "none"` |

Must not touch: any files in `crates/`, `apps/admin/`, `apps/edge/`, `bot/`, `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, or `spec/`.
Governed by: SPEC §9.5 (Play together) and ruling [[R3732002]] (friends drawer and page layout/styles).

## Steps

1. In `apps/web/src/together/together.css`, locate `.together-field:focus-visible` (lines 147–150):
   ```css
   .together-field:focus-visible {
     outline: none;
     border-color: var(--you);
   }
   ```
   Delete `outline: none;`, leaving:
   ```css
   .together-field:focus-visible {
     border-color: var(--you);
   }
   ```
   This allows `:where(button, input, a):focus-visible` in `apps/web/src/index.css:420` (`outline: 2px solid var(--radiant); outline-offset: 2px;`) to supply the focus outline while keeping the border color change to `var(--you)`.

2. In `e2e/cypress/component/friends-screen.cy.tsx`, update `expectThemedFields()` (lines 148–168):
   Inside the loop over `[TOGETHER_ADD_INPUT, TOGETHER_SEARCH]`, after the checks on ground, line, and radius, add keyboard focus and the outline check following the pattern from `e2e/cypress/component/mobile-ux.cy.tsx:758`:
   ```ts
   (field as HTMLElement & { focus(options?: { focusVisible?: boolean }): void }).focus({ focusVisible: true });
   expect(win.getComputedStyle(field).outlineStyle, `${id} has a focus outline`).not.to.eq("none");
   field.blur();
   ```
   Update the helper's docstring to note the focus outline check.

## Tests

1. `e2e/cypress/component/friends-screen.cy.tsx`:
   - `R3732002 the add and search fields wear the theme's field style and are 44 px tall on the page at ${size.label}` (asserts ground, line, radius, 44px height, and focused `outlineStyle !== "none"` on page at all `MENU_SIZES`).
   - `R3732002 the add and search fields wear the theme's field style and are 44 px tall in the drawer at ${size.label}` (asserts ground, line, radius, 44px height, and focused `outlineStyle !== "none"` in drawer at all `MENU_SIZES`).
2. Verification commands:
   - `NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=4096" pnpm --dir e2e run typecheck:component`
   - `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e`
   - `cargo fmt --check`
   - `cargo jackioh catalog check`
   - `cargo jackioh patches check`
   - `cargo jackioh spec check`

## Done when

- [ ] `outline: none;` is deleted from `.together-field:focus-visible` in `apps/web/src/together/together.css`.
- [ ] `expectThemedFields()` in `e2e/cypress/component/friends-screen.cy.tsx` asserts `win.getComputedStyle(field).outlineStyle !== "none"` when focused for both `TOGETHER_ADD_INPUT` and `TOGETHER_SEARCH`.
- [ ] `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e` passes with zero errors or warnings.
- [ ] `NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=4096" pnpm --dir e2e run typecheck:component` typechecks without errors in modified files.
- [ ] All harness checks (`cargo fmt --check`, `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `cargo jackioh patches check`, `cargo jackioh spec check`) are green.

## Risks

- **Focus spillover in component tests:** Omitting `field.blur()` after the assertion could leave focus on the input, potentially interfering with subsequent layout or hit-area assertions. Avoided by explicitly calling `field.blur()` immediately after the `outlineStyle` assertion.
- **Specificity regressions:** Adding an explicit outline selector could accidentally conflict with other inputs or override user-agent settings. Avoided by simply deleting the property and allowing `index.css:420`'s `:where()` rule to apply naturally.

## Open questions

None.

| File | Status | Changes |

Governed by: SPEC §9.5 (Play together) and ruling [[R3732002]] (friends drawer and page layout/styles).

## Steps

1. In `apps/web/src/together/together.css`, locate `.together-field:focus-visible` (lines 147–150):
   ```css
   .together-field:focus-visible {
     outline: none;
     border-color: var(--you);
   }
   ```
   Delete `outline: none;`, leaving:
   ```css
   .together-field:focus-visible {
     border-color: var(--you);
   }
   ```
   This allows `:where(button, input, a):focus-visible` in `apps/web/src/index.css:420` (`outline: 2px solid var(--radiant); outline-offset: 2px;`) to supply the focus outline while keeping the border color change to `var(--you)`.

2. In `e2e/cypress/component/friends-screen.cy.tsx`, update `expectThemedFields()` (lines 148–168):
   Inside the loop over `[TOGETHER_ADD_INPUT, TOGETHER_SEARCH]`, after the checks on ground, line, and radius, add keyboard focus and the outline check following the pattern from `e2e/cypress/component/mobile-ux.cy.tsx:758`:
   ```ts
   (field as HTMLElement & { focus(options?: { focusVisible?: boolean }): void }).focus({ focusVisible: true });
   expect(win.getComputedStyle(field).outlineStyle, `${id} has a focus outline`).not.to.eq("none");
   field.blur();
   ```
